intro: We do not publish a square-foot price, because on this side of the mountain the number is decided by what is under your project rather than by what you pick to walk on. A flat, well-drained lot with easy machine access is a genuinely different job from a sloped one that needs a retaining wall, a stair run, and drainage work before a single paver goes down. Quoting you a headline rate before we have seen your grades would mean either padding it or changing it later, and we are not interested in doing either. So the process is this: we come out, take measurements and grades, talk about budget honestly and early, and give you a written estimate with the materials named and the scope spelled out. If the number does not work, we will tell you what can come out or what can wait for a second phase rather than quietly thinning the base to hit a price.
notes: Free on-site consultation and estimate across Mountain Top and Luzerne County. Deck projects include the permits, which we secure on your behalf.
